title: Page
summary: Whether you're turning a funny chat into an original song, giving a friend's Snap a creative AI-enhanced or creating your own custom caption font, Lens+ unlocks new ways to bring conversations and creativity to life.
body_markdown:
Last year, we introduced[Lens+](https://newsroom.snap.com/introducing-lens-plus) , our premium subscription tier that gives Snapchatters access to exclusive Lenses and immersive AR experiences. Now, we're expanding the Lens+ experience with even more ways to create, remix and express yourself.


Whether you're turning a funny chat into an original song, giving a friend's Snap a creative AI-enhanced or creating your own custom caption font, Lens+ unlocks new ways to bring conversations and creativity to life.


**Make your Message Sing**


Transform chat messages into short original songs.


Simply press and hold a message in Chat, select Create Song, choose a musical genre to generate a version of your chat set to music. Before sending, you can preview your creation, then share it directly in the conversation to surprise your friends and make sure your message was memorable.


**Rescue Your Best Snaps**


Not every great Snap happens with perfect timing. With AI Photoshoot, quickly clean up those almost-favorite photos—whether someone blinked, looked away, got caught making a funny face, or simply stuck in some bad lighting—so you can share the moment you *meant* to capture without needing to retake the shot.


**Remix Snaps**


Creatively respond to the Snaps your friends send you with AI Remix. With this feature, Lens+ subscribers can reimagine a Snap from a friend in an entirely new style, creating a playful, unexpected version that builds on the original moment and continues the conversation.


**Give Your Stickers a Fresh Look**


Reinvent a custom, saved, or received Sticker in a range of styles to keep riffing as conversations flow.


**Make Your Captions Stand Out**


Give your captions a whole new look with AI-enhanced fonts. Whether you're going for bubble letters, fuzzy textures, spray paint, foam, or something completely unexpected, Lens+ lets you transform ordinary text into creative designs that help your Snaps stand out and keep every caption on theme.


**Even More Ways to Create with Lens+**


These new experiences build on the growing collection of exclusive Lenses and creative tools available through Lens+, a tier within Snapchat+ that gives subscribers even more AI-powered ways to create. Snapchat+ now reaches more than 25 million subscribers around the world.


The new Lens+ experiences are rolling out now in all markets where Lens+ is available, but access may vary by region over the coming weeks.


Happy Snapping!
